algorithm.name: 两重载核交替归约collector
algorithm.method: Exact stage guard; keep every original lane on its fixed owner and every pure scalar ADD local. Exactly two maximum lane-work cores alternate as collector for mixed original ADDs. Original graph/tree unchanged. One direct singleton plan and one online E0, no search or online comparison.

offline_costs: No offline training or graph-specific evaluation precomputation. Development and pure mathematical proxy validation are separate from solver wall and invoke no E0; no new dependency or native compilation.

parameters.selection: one direct construction; no online comparison

memory.scope: sum of process-group RSS / Windows job WorkingSetSize; sampled tripwire, not OS hard limit; shared pages may be counted more than once

solver_process.log_derivation: stdout/stderr preserve bytes except repository and interpreter absolute paths replaced by markers

metadata.guard: constant-input homogeneous vector-lane chains + unchanged binary scalar ADD tree + scalar broadcast stage chain
metadata.order: per stage: full original lane chains, pure-local original ADDs, mixed ADDs on alternating heavy collector
metadata.legality: compute/plan static validation only, no memory or full official feasibility claim

solver_receipt.timing_note: Disjoint main-phase timers exclude startup and final receipt/publication; outer process wall is authoritative. One candidate only; no online comparison or non-regression guarantee.
